body: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.
summaryZh: 本文介绍了MatrixFormer，一种专门用于矩阵补全任务的预训练基础模型。不同于以往将矩阵补全视为逐个条目预测的传统方法，MatrixFormer采用矩阵原生Transformer架构，能够一次性预测缺失值的完整分布。该模型在因果推断、表格填充及推荐系统等多种任务中表现出优异的零样本迁移能力，证明了其作为通用矩阵补全基础模型的潜力，为处理二维结构化数据提供了更高效的建模方案。

glossary.explanationZh: 矩阵补全，指从部分观测值中恢复矩阵缺失条目的过程。
表格填充，指对表格数据中的缺失值进行预测和补全。
潜在因子，指在矩阵分解模型中用于表示数据内在特征的隐变量。
零样本，指模型在未经过特定任务微调的情况下直接进行推理的能力。
